message:
[SYCL][UR] Add `UR_DEVICE_INFO_FP16_ATOMIC` for querying 16-bit atomic support (#23420)

`aspect::ext_oneapi_atomic16` was derived from the
`cl_ext_float_atomics` extension string, which the L0 adapter had to
fake and which OpenCL devices (e.g. Gen12) report with only partial fp16
atomic capabilities. Replace it with a dedicated boolean device-info
query.

`aspect::ext_oneapi_atomic16` != `cl_ext_float_atomics` - driver can
report `cl_ext_float_atomics` without or with partial 16-bit support.

Fix CMPLRLLVM-78545
